summary: Event risk on held names was quiet today: no 8-K 4.01, 4.02, 5.02 or large 1.01/2.01 on any holding, and the only held-name print in the window (CARG, 11-05 after the close) resolved as mixed. Q3 adj EPS $0.70 vs $0.66 and sales $258.4M vs $256.5M beat, FY26 adj EPS guide was raised to $2.66-$2.72 (vs $2.63) with a $250M buyback, but the Q4 sales guide of $258.5M-$263.5M sits just under the $263.5M estimate and FY sales guidance was narrowed. CARG fell 6.7% on the day (close.json change_today), so the market read the soft Q4 guide more harshly than the PM's 'mixed-to-positive' reading; the position is still +7.5% on cost and about 16% above the $28.25 stop, so no thesis clause tripped. The rest of the book's moves came from the tape (payrolls 165K vs 65K expected, the post-midterm AI/Nasdaq rout, SPY roughly -4% over the session on the 11-05 close): DPZ -2.3%, KR -2.5%, MSCI -2.3%, WMT -1.9% fell together, which is what the Consumer Staples stacking concern (L3) predicts, though it is one day and not graded evidence. BTC/USD is the live name: close.json marks it near $75.8k (13.285 / 0.000175228), about 0.7% above the $75.3k stop (10% under the $83,686 fill). The crypto headlines (CLARITY Act rewrite to expand SEC powers and possibly delay regulation, Warren expected to chair Senate Banking in 2027, Datavault CEO fired, Core Scientific exiting mining, Greek 10% crypto gains tax) are regulatory-timing and sentiment items; none is an exchange failure or enacted adverse action, so the thesis's qualitative clause is still untripped on the news, and the price stop is what matters. Lessons applied: L2 (every held name's own earnings date and filings checked against news.json; GPOR, DBX and BJRI, open in earlier runs, are now resolved by their 11-04/11-05 8-K 2.02 filings, none held) and L5 (stop distances computed from close.json marks). I did not use news_memory beyond the lesson text and did not re-read the later pages of learning.json, so continuity calls below rest on the 11-04 memory entries I saw (BTC exchange-failure clause judged untripped, DPZ guidance-cut item unverified).
